title: Mining ESG & Sustainability
thesis: Snowflake automates ESG reporting at mining scale — Dynamic Tables aggregate scope 1-3 emissions, water usage, and community impact; ML detects anomalous discharge events; Cortex AI drafts GRI-aligned sustainability reports

talking_points: Scope 1+2 emissions at 1.2M tCO2e — tracking 8% above 2025 reduction pathway.
Water recycling rate at 78% — target is 85% by year-end.
Zero fatalities this year; LTIFR at 1.8 per million hours — below industry benchmark.
show: Point at emissions vs target trend line
tabs.call_out: 8% above emissions pathway — water recycling 7 points below target

transition.line: Let's drill into what's driving the emissions gap.

talking_points: RKEF smelters are the primary emissions source — 72% of Scope 1.
ML.FORECAST projects year-end at 1.35M tCO2e vs 1.25M target — 80,000 tonne gap.
Two discharge monitoring points showing anomalous readings — possible tailings seepage.
show: Show emissions breakdown by source pie chart
tabs.call_out: 80,000 tCO2e gap to target — 2 discharge anomalies flagged

transition.line: The environmental data is concerning. Let's check tailings risk.

talking_points: Four tailings storage facilities monitored — TSF-3 at 82% capacity, highest risk score.
Real-time stability monitoring with 50,000 data points from piezometers and inclinometers.
Safety performance: 2,000 incidents logged, 94% near-miss reporting rate.
tabs.call_out: TSF-3 at 82% capacity — highest risk score among 4 facilities

transition.line: Now let the VP ask about reporting readiness.

talking_points: Dr. Yanti asks: 'Are we on track to meet our 2025 emissions target?'
Cortex Analyst queries forecast — returns: no, projected 8% above target, recommends RKEF efficiency.
Follow-up: 'Generate the GRI 305 emissions disclosure narrative' — AI produces report-ready text.
show: Switch to advisory mode for GRI narrative
tabs.call_out: Two AI modes: ESG analytics + GRI report generation

transition.line: Every capability — native Snowflake SQL, native ML.

talking_points: Six Snowflake capabilities, six AWS services in the dual-build architecture.
Iceberg tables share verified ESG data with investors and rating agencies.
Indonesia's nickel mining sector under increasing ESG scrutiny from EV supply chain.
tabs.call_out: One platform, automated ESG reporting, open data for investors

transition.line: That's Snowflake and AWS — better together for mining ESG.
